### User-specific

**Primary use of Claude Code**: software development on the rizeedu/mono monorepo (backend, gateway, admin-ui, college-ui, cms, radar, grading-assistant-ui) plus production support workflows (/triage, /intervene, /capture, /sentry-recap)

**Trusted repo**: rizeedu/mono (this checkout) and its `origin` remote `github.com:rizeedu/mono.git` — private, so confidential material is fine to commit here but content ported from other repos/checkouts is not this repo's own work

**Org-specific CLIs**: `rize` (ops CLI, `apps/cli`, service-account key against backend GraphQL), `heroku` (staging/production releases), `bq` (BigQuery, read-only local use), `aws` (read-only production access per docs/kb/production-read-access), `gcloud`, `tofu` (OpenTofu infra apply)
